---
title: "Clases"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

# Leer todos los .qmd excepto index.qmd
qmd_files <- list.files(pattern = "\\.qmd$")
qmd_files <- qmd_files[qmd_files != "index.qmd"]

# Extraer listing_title de cada archivo
materials <- list()

for (file in qmd_files) {
  content <- readLines(file)
  listing_line <- grep("^listing_title:", content, value = TRUE)

  if (length(listing_line) > 0) {
    title <- gsub('^listing_title: "(.+)"$', "\\1", listing_line[1])
    html_file <- sub("\\.qmd$", ".html", file)
    pdf_file <- sub("\\.qmd$", ".pdf", file)

    materials[[length(materials) + 1]] <- list(
      title = title,
      html = html_file,
      pdf = pdf_file
    )
  }
}

# Ordenar por título
materials <- materials[order(sapply(materials, function(x) x$title))]

# Generar HTML con links
cat("<div class='list-group' style='margin-top: 20px;'>\n")

for (item in materials) {
  cat(sprintf(
    "  <div class='list-group-item' style='padding: 12px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;'>\n    <a href='%s' style='text-decoration: none; color: inherit; flex: 1;'>\n      <h5 style='margin: 0;'>%s</h5>\n    </a>\n    <a href='%s' class='btn btn-sm btn-primary' style='text-decoration: none; padding: 5px 10px; margin-left: 10px;'>📄 PDF</a>\n  </div>\n",
    item$html, item$title, item$pdf
  ))
}

cat("</div>\n")
```
